title: no README.md in either crate
description: Neither mime-tree/ nor smime-tree/ has a README.md. crates.io shows a blank description page; Rust doc pages have no overview. A new user or potential contributor has no entry point beyond reading CLAUDE.md (which is intended for AI agents, not humans) or src/lib.rs. Scenario: first-time user discovers the crate on crates.io, sees no README, and cannot understand what it does or how to use it without reading the full source — this generates avoidable issue reports.
